    <Authors>Contoso Engineering</Authors>

```xml

  </PropertyGroup>

  </ItemGroup>

`Core`, `Services`, and `Api` each have two separate `<PropertyGroup>` blocks — the main one and a second for `DocumentationFile`. These should be merged into a single `<PropertyGroup>` for readability (though after centralization this is moot since `DocumentationFile` moves out entirely).
